programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Les nains de jardin de la Mouffette ont été repeints ! Le seul indice : un klaxon qui joue la Cucaracha... exactement comme celui d'Hermine. Sherlock mène l'enquête. En parallèle, le Castor a été ligoté à un arbre. Ses chansons moqueuses auraient-elles énervé Croco, Otarie ou Chef Panda ? Pendant ce temps, Hermine accuse Sherlock d'être radin…

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: La maîtresse montre à Lulu une sculpture faite d'objets assemblés et propose de créer une œuvre collective. Les idées fusent, entre sérieux et absurdité, jusqu'à ce que Lulu trouve l'inspiration. Pendant ce temps, les amis cherchent un cadeau pour Brico, qui préfère réparer son coucou suisse tranquillement.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pour augmenter son stock de croquettes Grabouillon organise une kermesse truquée où personne ne gagne, sauf lui. Vexé par Bagou, il entraîne la famille Pucekipick dans un spectacle raté. Pour éviter de porter des paquets, lui et Bagou simulent une maladie mais Pétunia les piège avec une fausse quarantaine. Quand elle le fait peser, il trafique la balance et se retrouve menacé de vermifuge.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: En 1959 à La Havane, Coda rejoint les guérilleros et devient chef après avoir détruit la statue de Batista. Sur Hollywood Boulevard, il décroche un rôle d'extra-terrestre, mais doit échapper à un acteur jaloux. Pour Noël, il devient doudou d'une fillette redoutable. En Judée, il sauve un bébé auréolé poursuivi par un soldat romain. Coda survivra-t-il ?

programme.title: Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or
programme.desc: Le Grand Condor emmène nos amis vers l'Ouest, en suivant le soleil. À la tombée de la nuit, le Condor atterrit. Mais l'armée espagnol de Pizarro surgit alors.

programme.title: Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or
programme.desc: Nos héros retournent au Vieux Pic pour obtenir des renseignements sur le pays Maya. Sur place, ils découvrent que Gomez et ses hommes tentent de prendre d'assaut de la vieille ville.

programme.title: Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or
programme.desc: Malgré les vents terribles et les gigantesques vagues, Mendoza réussit à franchir le détroit de Magellan sans dommage. De la cale, Esteban et Zia découvrent les splendeurs de ces terres glaciales. Dès qu'Esteban apparaît sur le pont, le soleil revient.

programme.title: Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or
programme.desc: La tornade va s'abattre sur le navire, pour se protéger les marins doivent s'arrimer au bateau, sans quoi ils risquent d'être projetés dans la mer déchaînée... Le navire prend l'eau et menace de se briser. La cale se remplit d'eau, Mendoza décide d'aller délivrer les enfants dans la cale. Va-t-il parvenir à temps pour les sauver ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Rien-Ne-Sert prépare un cadeau surprise pour Lulu, sans lui en parler. Curieuse, Lulu fait tout pour découvrir ce que son ami cache. Ensemble, ils décident de jouer une farce à leurs amis en leur faisant croire qu'ils ont invoqué un monstre. Mais quand des événements étranges surviennent, ils se demandent : et si un vrai monstre rôdait vraiment ?

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Pétunia doit faire un exposé sur une fleur exotique, mais Grabouillon oublie de fermer la serre et la fleur fane. Avec Bagou, il fabrique une réplique en papier. Pour gagner une trottinette, Grabouillon triche à la tombola, mais perd. Après avoir déclenché une allergie aux Pucekipik, il promet à Pétunia de tout réparer. Pour prouver son savoir, il organise un quiz… et triche !

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Carmen, Carmélito et Bélino raccompagnent une fillette en cape rouge chez sa grand-mère. Sur le chemin, un loup réclame la galette… que Bélino a déjà mangée ! Heureusement, Pédro en prépare une autre. Plus tard, en forêt de Brocéliande, un chapeau magique sème le chaos au poulailler. Grâce à Merlin, jeune sorcier, tout rentre dans l'ordre !

programme.title: L'incroyable Noël de Grabouillon
programme.desc: Le soir de Noël, Grabouillon envoie des signaux vers le ciel pour attirer l'attention du Père Noël. Décontenancé par les gesticulations du toutou, le Père Noël perd alors le contrôle de son traîneau et se retrouve naufragé sur la Lune…

programme.title: L'incroyable Noël de Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon, un chien gaffeur, est le compagnon de jeu de Pétunia, une petite fille plutôt sage qu'il entraîne dans ses bêtises. D'autres animaux les suivent.

programme.title: Fêtes surprises
programme.desc: Gâteaux, cadeaux et belles surprises : la prairie adore faire la fête, et Maya est toujours au cœur de l'amusement.

programme.title: Pagaille dans la prairie
programme.desc: Coquilles cassées et boules en fuite : suivez Maya et ses amis quand les jeux du quotidien tournent à la joyeuse pagaille.

programme.title: Drôles d'abeilles
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à rire ! Cette collection rassemble les moments les plus loufoques et hilarants de la prairie.

programme.title: La grande journée de Willy
programme.desc: Adorable, paresseux et toujours affamé, Willy est la vedette d'une collection pleine de ses moments les plus drôles.

programme.title: Petits coups de main
programme.desc: Dès que quelqu'un a un souci, Maya est la première à aider, prouvant que la gentillesse est le plus grand pouvoir de la prairie.

programme.title: Apprendre à partager
programme.desc: Trésors sucrés et bons festins sont meilleurs partagés : Maya apprend à la prairie la joie de donner.

programme.title: Petites bêtes, grands cœurs
programme.desc: Scarabées, escargots et araignées : Maya découvre que même les plus petites bêtes ont les plus grands cœurs.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger
programme.desc: S2:E7 Pingu construit une tour | Pingu le roi | Pingu le boulanger - Pingu voit dans un livre une tour qui monte jusqu'au ciel et veut en construire une identique. | Pinga découvre un livre sur les royaumes et Pingu pense que ce serait génial d'être roi. | Pingu veut faire son propre gâteau.

programme.title: Pingu
programme.sub-title: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu
programme.desc: S2:E8 Pingu et la poupée | Pingu aide grand-père | La mauvaise journée de Pingu - Le bras de l'ours de Pinga se détache quand Pingu joue avec. | Pingu part à pied aider grand-père à cause des retards de la motoneige. | Pingu trébuche sur ses jouets, fait un mauvais trajet jusqu'à l'école et ne sait pas répondre au maître.

programme.title: Pingu

programme.desc: C'est à nouveau l'heure de la compétition de danse de Fraisi-Paradis ! Prunetille est stressée et exténuée : elle veut absolument gagner ! Mais ses adversaires sont redoutables. Elles sont élégantes et synchronisées à merveille....

programme.title: Charlotte aux Fraises
programme.desc: Les filles sont toutes réunies au café. Charlotte essaie de faire de la compote de pommes maison à l'aide d'un maillet (et fait en fait plein de cochonneries), tandis que les autres sont occupées à fabriquer leurs propres papiers cadeaux et...

programme.desc: Lili Framboise est bouleversée. Elle soupçonne ses amies d'avoir copié la lanterne qu'elle a créée pour le Bal de la fraise scintillante. Et puis, elle découvre la véritable signification du festival.

Le seul ami du seigneur du crime est son protégé, un assassin qui a ses propres problèmes. Une bataille épique entre lieutenants et chefs du crime s'engage. Un seul en sortira vivant… ou peut-être aucun.

programme.desc: Dans ce récit de Noël réconfortant, le vrai père Noël (Leslie Nielsen) tombe de son traîneau et développe l'amnésie. Il tombe rapidement sur un journaliste de télévision blasé qui est son seul espoir de retrouver sa mémoire à temps pour sauver ses vacances.

programme.desc: La veille de Noël, la famille Nolan se retrouve transportée au Pôle Nord, où le Père Noël leur annonce qu'il a besoin de leur aide pour sauver Noël!

programme.title: Double Destinée
programme.desc: Eve, une organisatrice de fêtes qui doit choisir entre un événement de dernière minute et des vacances romantiques. Tandis qu'elle réfléchit à ces deux perspectives, laquelle choisira-t-elle?

programme.title: Home by Christmas
programme.desc: Après avoir divorcé de son mari infidèle, une femme aisée se retrouve sans domicile fixe à la suite d'une série de mésaventures

programme.title: Three Fighters
programme.desc: Alexandra D'Artagnan, jeune membre de la NSA découvre qu'une conspiration a pour projet d'assassiner le Président Américain. Avec l'aide de trois autres espions de renommée internationale, ils vont tenter de l'empêcher.

programme.title: Justice Armée
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il apprend que son frère a été assassiné pendant son service militaire, Webster se met à la recherche des auteurs du meurtre. Il découvre alors une conspiration qui remonte jusqu'au gouvernement américain.

programme.desc: Pasha, 18 ans, sauve Dana, une mystérieuse jeune femme attaquée par des individus surpuissants. Entraîné dans un monde souterrain peuplé de créatures démoniaques, il découvre que les vampires vivent parmi les humains. Une chasse mortelle commence…

programme.title: Sentinel
programme.desc: Des années après qu'une invasion extraterrestre a presque anéanti l'humanité, réfugiés dans une base secrète sur la Lune, trois héros décident de voyager dans le temps dans une tentative désespérée de sauver les survivants. Mais ils ignorent que le Sentinel les attend.

programme.title: Le portefeuille
programme.desc: Un jour, un homme trouve un portefeuille par terre. Ou bien, ne l'a-t-il pas vu ? Il décide de le rendre à son propriétaire et aussi de le garder pour lui.

programme.title: L'évasion
programme.desc: Un homme est en prison. Son compagnon de cellule est torturé jusqu'à la mort. Quand ses geôliers viennent le chercher à son tour, il parvient à s'enfuir dans l'enceinte du bâtiment. Geste désespéré car il s'agit d'un vrai labyrinthe. Il échappe pourtant à ses poursuivants jusqu'au toit de l'immeuble. Du haut des miradors, un militaire le tient en joue. Là il exprime devant eux toute la mesure de sa liberté.

programme.title: Nimbus Machina
programme.desc: Le désert, le vent, un rail. Une étrange machine passe et crache de gigantesques nuages de vapeur et de suie.

programme.title: Ephémères
programme.desc: Sur le mur d'une vieille maison, un éphémère cherche sa place parmi les photos de famille.

programme.title: Train de vie

programme.title: T'étais où quand Michaël Jackson est mort ?

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Des millions de larmes
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une rencontre dans un café-restaurant désert le long d'une route. Un homme d'une soixantaine d'années qui attend là. Une jeune femme fait son entrée, un sac sur le dos, sa vie dedans et la mine passablement fatiguée. Il lui propose de l'avancer. Elle accepte.

programme.title: Bande démo
programme.desc: Samir est un comédien Belge, débrouillard, beau parleur, mais habitué aux complications à répétition. Lorsqu'il parvient à décrocher ce rendez-vous avec un agent important, les choses se compliquent lorsque ce dernier lui demande d'apporter sa bande démo…

programme.title: Bang Bang !
programme.desc: Bang ! Bang ! C'est l'ouverture de la chasse. Et aussi l'anniversaire d'Éda : vingt-cinq ans. Pour fêter ça, son père lui offre un appartement qui vient d'être saisi. Happy Birthday ! Éda fuit. Elle roule vite, trop vite. Quand un chien rose surgit dans ses phares, c'est l'accident. Effrayée par l'étrange animal, elle s'engouffre dans la forêt où son père mène la chasse…

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Robin se fait larguer par sa copine, Annie, parce qu'il n'arrive pas à lui exprimer ses sentiments. Aidé de son chien, il va tout faire pour la récupérer.

programme.title: Mortal break-up inferno
programme.desc: La traque infernale d'un jeune homme par sa copine qui n'a pas digéré leur rupture.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: A l'ombre du voile
programme.desc: Deux femmes musulmanes, une mère et sa fille, se rendent à une manifestation contre l'interdiction du voile à l'école. De retour à la maison, la mère invite sa fille à abandonner ce voile à travers une danse désespérée et troublante.

programme.title: Le pont
programme.desc: Un homme et son fils vivent au sommet d'un pic escarpé, totalement coupés du monde extérieur : le père a veillé à tenir son fils éloigné des réalités de l'humanité. Mais une nuit, l'enfant aperçoit, en bas de la falaise, une ville dont les lumières brillent.

programme.title: Paix sur la terre
programme.desc: La nuit tombe quelque part sur la terre. Ca et là, des ovoïdes traversent le ciel et s'abattent sur le sol. Peu après, on retrouve des sièges vides et des cannes à pêche plantées dans l'herbe... Tout devient extrêmement calme.

programme.title: Fugue
programme.desc: Un petit bonhomme tout à fait quelconque veut prendre soin d'une jeune pousse en la mettant au soleil. Dans un filet, il capture un nuage pour pouvoir abreuver la plante, mais celui-ci, se transformant en eau, glisse au travers des mailles. Le petit bonhomme tentera par tous les moyens de rattraper ce filet d'eau indispensable au bien-être de sa plante.

programme.title: Les yeux de la tête
programme.desc: John, un grand acteur américain, alors qu'il joue amicalement un trou au golf en France, reçoit une balle en pleine figure et perd un oeil. Il peut cependant compter sur l'excellence de la médecine européenne et l'émergence de l'économie chinoise...

programme.title: Le printemps de Bernard
programme.desc: Bernard travaille à la patinoire municipale depuis toujours, mais il s'ennuie de plus en plus, il a froid. Un soir, en rentrant chez lui, il surprend une sculpture d'athlète en bronze en train de sortir de la douche. Au tour d'un plat de nouilles propices à toutes les confidences, ils se découvrent un rêve en commun : partir à la mer.

programme.title: C'est fini avec Loïc
programme.desc: Mélanie est une comédienne heureuse. Elle doit rencontrer aujourd'hui le réalisateur qu'elle admire le plus au monde. Mais le comportement de ce dernier va transformer le (son?) rêve en cauchemar...

programme.title: La nouvelle musique
programme.desc: Dans un univers semblable au nôtre, il n'existe qu'un seule musique. Appelé “la musique”, cette suite d'accords berce l'humanité depuis des siècles. Pour Tom, bientôt au chômage, cette suite est devenue insupportable.

programme.title: À cheval dans une maison vide
programme.desc: Au cours d'un voyage d'une journée, un adulte et un adolescent vont voir leur vie durablement modifiée. L'un est un éducateur spécialisé, l'autre est un adolescent sortant juste de prison.

programme.title: Chronique panoramique
programme.desc: Tous ces gens silencieux dans le train, qui sont-ils vraiment et à quoi peuvent-ils bien réfléchir en ce moment même ?

programme.title: Marche forcée
programme.desc: A l'occasion d'une classe verte dans les Cévennes, Lucas, professeur de français dans un lycée de banlieue, surprend deux de ses élèves, Samia et Djome, à l'écart en train de fumer de l'herbe mais bientôt le trio se perd dans le paysage de rivières et de forêts sauvages...

programme.title: Rupture
programme.desc: Renee Morgan vit avec son fils de 12 ans dans une banlieue américaine tranquille. Alors qu'elle fait banalement ses courses, elle est violemment kidnappée et se retrouve, 24h plus tard, attachée et interrogée sur sa phobie des araignées dans un laboratoire vide et anonyme. Les scientifiques, plutOt menaçants, lui expliquent que cette phobie pourrait lui permettre d'atteindre le niveau de « rupture » nécessaire à sa mutation…

programme.title: Double Tap
programme.desc: Un mystérieux tireur fait irruption au beau milieu d'une opération du FBI visant à démanteler un gang de trafiquants de drogue. L'homme élimine tous les gangsters, mais laisse en vie un agent infiltré, Kathleen Boyle.

programme.title: Death Ride To Osaka
programme.desc: Les yakuzas contraignent une chanteuse américaine (Jennifer Jason Leigh), recrutée dans une boîte de nuit à Tokyo, à devenir une esclave blanche.

programme.title: Le Majordome
programme.desc: Léopold, valet de chambre d'un vieil avocat en fin de carrière, mène une double vie. Grâce à sa connaissance du code pénal, il est un «juge» très apprécié et respecté de la pègre parisienne. Le docteur Ventoux, alias «le Chat», un cambrioleur célèbre pour son agilité, sollicite sa collaboration pour un gros coup. Léopold, qui bénéficie d'une solide expérience dans les commandos, accepte et recrute une petite équipe qu'il soumet à un dur entraînement. Au cours d'une soirée donnée par le procureur, il fait la connaissance d'Agnès, la fiancée de Ventoux, et s'en éprend. Afin d'arracher la jeune femme au «Chat», il décide de saboter le hold-up...

programme.title: La machine à démonter le temps
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à botter le passé avec "La machine à démonter le temps !" Les rires délirants éclatent lorsque quatre amis partagent une nuit folle à boire dans un jacuzzi de station de ski, pour se réveiller avec une gueule de bois atroce... en 1986.

programme.title: Stratton
programme.desc: Stratton, agent du MI6, s'infiltre avec son coéquipier Marty dans un laboratoire iranien pour intercepter le vol de molécules chimiques mortelles. Mais à leur arrivée, celles-ci ont déjà disparu et la mission tourne mal…

programme.title: L'île de Pascali
programme.desc: La tromperie est un mode de vie sur la belle île égéenne, où un triangle romantique se développe entre un espion de l'empire turc en déclin, un archéologue anglais et une expatriée sensuelle.

programme.title: Mack & Rita
programme.desc: Lors de l'enterrement de vie de jeune fille de sa meilleure amie à Palm Springs, Mackenzie Martin, 30 ans, ressort, par magie, sous la forme d'une femme de 70 ans, qu'elle appelle tante Rita.

programme.title: Grace Is Gone
programme.desc: Après avoir appris que sa femme a été tuée en Irak, un homme emmène ses deux filles en voyage en Floride et s'arrête en route pour voir sa famille.

programme.title: Les chaussures magiques
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon capture le cœur d'une nation en surmontant harcèlement, intolérance et une situation familiale désastreuse pour poursuivre son rêve de jouer au football.

programme.title: Aviator
programme.desc: Un biopic illustrant les premières années de la carrière légendaire du réalisateur et aviateur Howard Hughes, de la fin des années 1920 au milieu des années 1940.

programme.title: Frankie et Johnny
programme.desc: Love story moderne où lui (Al Pacino) travaille dans un restaurant grec après un bref séjour en prison et elle (Michelle Pfeiffer), serveuse dans le même restaurant, refuse toute relation sentimentale...

programme.title: From Prada to Nada FR
programme.desc: À la mort de leur père, deux sœurs jusque-là très gâtées doivent quitter les beaux quartiers pour aller vivre chez leur tante, dans un quartier latino de Los Angeles.

programme.title: G.I. Joe Conspiration
programme.desc: Piégés par leur ennemi mortel, les G.I Joes sont accusés d'un crime qu'ils n'ont pas commis. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) est aux commandes des G.I. (aux côtés de Channing Tatum et Bruce Willis) dans cette aventure explosive !

programme.title: GBF
programme.desc: Alors que l'élection de la fille la plus populaire du lycée bat son plein, les candidates font l'impossible pour s'attirer les faveurs de Tanner, dont elles entendent faire leur Gay Best Friend.

programme.desc: Les parcours de Florence Foresti, Omar Sy et Stromae, de leurs débuts au sommet de leur carrière.

programme.title: She's so lovely
programme.desc: Après avoir été libéré d'une institution psychiatrique, un homme tente de se racheter aux yeux de son ex-femme des événements qui ont conduit à son incarcération.

programme.title: Big Divorce
programme.desc: Fraîchement fiancé à Dylan, Michael se met en tête de retrouver son amour de jeunesse, Alex. La flamme renaît entre eux, et Michael envisage alors de rompre ses fiançailles.

programme.title: Sexy movie
programme.desc: Romantique absolue, Julia Jones a toujours cru au Grand Amour. Lorsqu'elle rencontre enfin l'Homme De Sa Vie, le très british Grant Funkyerdoder, elle croit tenir le bon bout. Mais c'est sans compter sur le retour d' Andy, l'ex de Grant, une vraie bombe sexuelle...

programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: L'histoire de Nathan Fisher, la trentaine, écrivain vivant à Brooklyn et dont la carrière est au point mort. Sa petite amie vient de le quitter et il apprend que son père est hospitalisé. Il décide alors de retourner en Floride pour s'occuper de sa famille.

programme.title: Vengeance du passé
programme.desc: Une femme retourne chez elle pour enquêter sur la mort mystérieuse de ses amis d'enfance.

programme.title: Mes Deux amours
programme.desc: Hadrien se lance à la recherche de la femme qu'il aime, Barbara, qui a disparu sans lui donner de nouvelles. Personne ne veut entendre ses angoisses sauf un autre homme, qui affirme à Hadrien que la femme de sa vie est la sienne... La rencontre entre les deux amants de Barbara a lieu à l'endroit où elle a été aperçue pour la dernière fois : la bergerie dont elle a hérité de sa mère. Hadrien Darcourt est arrivé en 4x4, Emmanuel Devailly, en stop. Hadrien est encore en costume, Emmanuel est déjà en tenue de campagne. Hadrien a fait appel à la gendarmerie, Emmanuel à son instinct. Bref, tout les oppose, mais ils aiment tous deux Barbara Cantarella, 45 ans, grand reporter

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: A la suite d'un jeu sexuel extrême, une jeune toxicomane est retrouvée morte dans un squat. La police est prévenue par deux garçons qui ont filmé la scène. Sur la vidéo, l'équipe de Hannah repère un individu masqué. Il s'agit d'un certain Skully, que Hannah est déterminé à retrouver au plus vite…

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: A la suite d'un jeu sexuel extrême, une jeune toxicomane est retrouvée morte dans un squat. La police est prévenue par deux garçons qui ont filmé la scène. Sur la vidéo, l'équipe de Hannah repère un individu masqué. Il s'agit d'un certain Skully, que Hannah est déterminé à retrouver au plus vite…

programme.title: La volante
programme.desc: Alors qu'il emmène sa femme à la maternité pour accoucher, Thomas percute et tue un jeune homme sur la route. Marie-France, la mère de ce dernier, ne parvient pas à se remettre du drame. Neuf ans plus tard, Marie-France devient la secrétaire de Thomas sans qu'il sache qui elle est.

programme.title: Mon Premier Miracle
programme.desc: Une ado atteinte d'un cancer rare devient amie avec un fugitif ensemble, ils assistent à un miracle.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: L'Amour à la Carte
programme.desc: Une cheffe audacieuse tombe amoureuse de l'héritier improbable d'une chaîne de fast-food mexicain.

programme.title: 5 Weddings
programme.desc: Une journaliste tombe amoureuse d'un homme parmi des danseurs trans et des chocs culturels.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sous les flocons
programme.desc: Une photographe en quête d'un rare flocon de neige à douze côtés embarque avec une amie d'enfance dans une aventure hivernale qui pourrait transformer leur vie.

programme.title: La Parade de Noël
programme.desc: Charlotte tente de raviver la tradition du défilé de trains de Noël pour son fils Benny. Avec l'aide du professeur de ce dernier, elle redécouvre l'esprit des fêtes… malgré des secrets du passé.

programme.title: Noël avec un inconnu
programme.desc: Adapté du best-seller. Darcy Archer est une romantique qui rêve d'être séduite par l'homme idéal. Un jour, alors qu'elle se rend au travail à vélo, Darcy percute accidentellement un bel inconnu élégant promenant son chien. Ce dernier perd connaissance et est transporté à l'hôpital, laissant derrière lui son chiot et un mystérieux cadeau de Noël. Tandis que Darcy aide Aidan à surmonter son amnésie, ils découvrent ensemble qui il est vraiment. Un baiser scellera-t-il la nuit de Noël ?

programme.title: Un Noël haute couture
programme.desc: La princesse Colette rêve de devenir créatrice de mode plutôt qu'héritière du trône. Amnésique à l'approche de Noël, elle découvre sa véritable vocation… et peut-être l'amour.

programme.title: Freaks of Nature
programme.desc: Dans la ville de Dillford, vampires, humains et zombies sont habitué de vivre ensemble, mais avec l'arrivée d'extraterrestres, il se produit que les humains commence à se battre contre les vampires et les Zombies dans un combat mortel. Trois adolescents doivent maintenant essayer de faire revenir les choses à la «normale».

programme.title: Big Daddy
programme.desc: Pour impressionner sa petite amie Vanessa et a la suite d'un quiproquo, Sonny, celibataire endurci, fait croire qu'il est le pere naturel de Julian, un jeune garcon de cinq ans qu'il adopte. C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: Ma Vie Sans Lui
programme.desc: Une jeune femme doit faire face à la mort de son mari et à la découverte de nombreux secrets le concernant...

programme.title: CLICK : télécommandez votre vie
programme.desc: Michael Newman (Adam Sandler) est marié à la belle Donna (Kate Beckinsale) ils ont deux adorables enfants, qu' il ne voit pas beaucoup parce qu'il passe trop de temps à son cabinet d'architecte.

programme.title: Braquage à New York
programme.desc: Henry, un percepteur de péage, est injustement emprisonné après avoir aidé sans le savoir des amis à commettre un vol de banque. En prison, il se lie d'amitié avec Max, un escroc charmant. Après avoir purgé sa peine, Henry découvre un vieux tunnel reliant la banque à un théâtre.

programme.title: Women In Trouble
programme.desc: Un jour dans la vie de 10 femmes à priori très différentes : une star du porno, une hôtesse de l'air, une psychiatre, une masseuse, une serveuse, deux call-girls, etc. Toutes ont un point commun : l'ennui.

programme.title: Little Manhattan
programme.desc: Dans une ville connue pour son effervescence, deux jeunes amis sont sur le point de se lancer dans la plus grande des aventures. Gabe et Rosemary se connaissent depuis presque toujours, mais lorsqu'ils se retrouvent face à face lors d'un cours de karaté, ils se voient sous un jour nouveau.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un entrepreneur militaire reconnu revient sur le site de ses plus grands triomphes de carrière et renoue avec un amour de son passé, tout en craquant de manière inattendue pour une dure à cuire de l'Air Force qui lui est assignée.

programme.title: Jet Lag
programme.desc: Le directeur zélé d'une petite entreprise américaine et ses deux associés partent en Europe pour conclure le contrat le plus important de leurs carrières. Mais ce qui commence comme un simple voyage d'affaire dérape rapidement et l'équipée se retrouve dans des situations improbables...

programme.title: La caravane vers l'Ouest
programme.desc: Deux caravanes de chariots convergent vers ce qui est aujourd'hui Kansas City et s'unissent pour se diriger vers l'Oregon.

programme.title: La reine de la prairie
programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones doit se battre contre un méchant éleveur pour récupérer les terres qui lui reviennent de droit.

programme.title: L'attaque du Fort Douglas
programme.desc: Un artiste travaillant dans un poste militaire isolé doit jongler entre la fille du commerçant, sa fiancée nouvellement arrivée de l'Est et la fille du chef indien.

programme.title: Adios California
programme.desc: Après la guerre civile, Michael « California » Random est libéré de prison et se rend dans le Missouri avec son partenaire William.

programme.title: La ruée sanglante
programme.desc: Un cow-boy aventurier et ancien militaire, ainsi qu'un riche industriel et innovateur, se disputent une concession pétrolière dans le Territoire indien de l'Oklahoma.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django est sur la piste de quelques hors-la-loi renégats qui ont violé et tué sa femme.

programme.title: Les Aigles noirs de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Lorsque les Comanches se mettent sur le sentier de la guerre, les colons se réfugient à Fort Eagle Rock, commandé par le capitaine Jackson. L'agent secret Cliff McPherson arrive dans ce fort en sous-effectif pour donner des conseils et apporter son soutien. Il apprend que les Comanches ont été attisés par Morton, un éleveur local qui veut prendre le contrôle du pétrole situé sous la réserve des Indiens.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Acquasanta Joe
programme.desc: Une bande de voleurs armés d'un canon de l'armée de l'Union dévalisent la banque où se trouve la prime du tueur Acquasanta Joe. Il se lance à leur poursuite, les croisant et les doublant sur son chemin.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Jennifer Beale est enlevée dans l'espoir que son riche père, Joshua, le baron de l'argent le plus riche du Comstock, paie une rançon d'un million de dollars. Le plan échoue lorsque la belle Della est tuée et qu'Hercule, qui l'aime, découvre le coupable.

programme.title: Deadsight
programme.desc: Un homme atteint de cécité partielle et une jeune policière enceinte doivent travailler ensemble pour échapper à un virus mortel qui s'est propagé dans le comté de Grey.

programme.title: Tuer La Bête
programme.desc: Une jeune fille, Elena, est confinée dans le monde des ténèbres, où elle mène une vie misérable. Son aîné, Facundo, est quant à lui resté au paradis, où il mène une vie paisible de médecin avec sa femme et ses deux filles.

programme.title: Yeti
programme.desc: Un avion s'écrase dans les montagnes de l'Himalaya. Pris au piège au milieu des falaises abruptes, les rescapés s'organisent pour leur survie. Ils sont attaqués par une créature affamée et assoiffée de sang: un abominable homme des neiges qui aime la chair humaine.

programme.title: Spasmo
programme.desc: Christian tombe amoureux d'une mystérieuse jeune femme. Quand un homme fait irruption dans leur chambre d'hôtel et que Christian le tue accidentellement, les choses deviennent de plus en plus irrationnelles.

programme.title: Le projet atticus

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Sam Claflin Asks What Is Body Dysmorphia?
programme.desc: Actor Sam Claflin discusses his lifelong struggle with body dysmorphia and body image with Fearne Cotton. Sam explains what having body dysmorphia means to him and how it affects everything from the food he eats to his willingness to watch his own films back. Fearne and Sam discuss being chronic people pleasers and how they're working to stop putting everyone else's comfort before their own. Sam reflects on how he was brought up to think about masculinity and what he's doing to ensure his own son grows up with gentler male role models. They also reminisce about the early days of MSN and webcam chatrooms.

programme.title: Chris Appleton: From Being Bullied to Styling the Kardashians
programme.desc: Celebrity hair stylist Chris Appleton chats with Fearne about why we change our hair when we want to start over. Chris explains that everyone from the Kardashians to cancer patients have opened up to him about their insecurities, and he's seen the profound impact that looking more like yourself on the outside can have on how you feel about yourself on the inside. He's fascinated by the self-limiting beliefs people have about who they are. Chris has dealt with a lot of his own shame and fears too. He was bullied at school, struggled to acknowledge his sexuality, and had huge imposter syndrome when he first arrived in Hollywood. He also gives Fearne a consultation about going bolder with her hair. Content warning: this episode contains frank conversation about suicidal ideation.

programme.title: Jimmy Carr on Feminism, Parenting, and Success
programme.desc: Comedian Jimmy Carr discusses defining success without comparing yourself to others, the importance of hard work, and why he doesn't fear cancel culture. He explains his views on feminism and motherhood, why he refuses to use the term "babysitting" for parenting his own children, and how his anxieties fuel his comedy.

programme.title: Nafessa Williams On Racism, Sexism, and Rivals
programme.desc: Rivals actress Nafessa Williams discusses playing the only black woman in a white man's world in 1980s Britain, and how she sees her acting as her contribution to activism and representation. She explores what it means to be on a TV show with intimate scenes, the journey from law to acting, manifestation and taking action, faith and optimism, and the importance of rest alongside ambition.

programme.title: Carol Vorderman Talks Politics, Education, and Parenting
programme.desc: Broadcaster Carol Vorderman discusses her early life, from her family running away with the circus and living out of a car, to being one of the first girls to read engineering at Cambridge University. She reveals who wrote her first application to Countdown and explains why everything about our lives is political, from the pressure put on kids and parents by schools to women's bodily autonomy.

With menus and centerpieces designed to resemble game cards, and a plan to have their guests pay for their food with fake money, David wonders if they've been planning a wedding or a child's birthday party! Things get worse when David finds out that neither Tasha nor her brides like their dresses, which are far too revealing, and to top it off, they're planning on having the ceremony and reception in a friend's back yard! David had just three weeks to keep this couple's dreams from going directly to jail!

programme.title: Belly Dancing Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's weddings work best when his couples incorporate something from their own life into their wedding as their theme, but when he meets Shirley and Andy from Los Angeles, California, he finds a theme that poses a huge challenge: belly dancing. Shirley absolutely loves her hobby but may have gone a little overboard in her planning: she plans to put herself and her brides in noisy shimmy belts, has peacock feather centerpieces, and to top it all off, she's had a fake foam cake made to save money! Shirley's bridesmaid dresses are a mismatched mess that don't fit their body types, and when David sees Shirley's dress, he's floored by how big and dramatic it is, not at all matching Shirley's personality or her theme. David's biggest challenge might be yet to come, however, because Shirley's venue for the wedding is a small Indian restaurant! In three weeks, David has to take this mismatched mess of a wedding and turn it into the ultimate sexy, exotic celebration of the art of belly dancing.

programme.title: Royal Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera is used to his brides wanting to feel like royalty on their wedding day, but when he meets Tracey from Sherman Oaks, California, he finds a bride who's take that idea even further! Tracey wants the have the ultimate royal wedding, complete with crowns and miniature castles, but when she shows David some of her wedding materials, he sees the making of a royal disaster. The items Tracey has put together are mismatched, and don't speak to the regal, opulent feel that Tracey's is looking for, and neither her gown nor her bridesmaids dresses are appropriate for a royal wedding. David has only three weeks to change every aspect of Tracey's wedding to give her the royal wedding she's always wanted.

programme.title: Make-A-Wish Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera approaches every wedding with an open heart and an open mind. But few stories have touched David as much as bride Wendy and groom Rocky's. This couple put their wedding plans on hold when Wendy's teenage son, Ryan, received a life-threatening diagnosis of cancer. Thankfully, Ryan's cancer is now in remission, and this generous young man wants to pay his good fortune forward. Ryan asked the Make-A-Wish Foundation to bring David Tutera to Topeka, Kansas, to give his mom the wedding she's been waiting for. But Wendy's dress is a disaster, and so are the rest of the wedding details. Now David has six days to create a wedding like nothing Topeka has ever seen before!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29

Thanks to Jeongi's foresight in testing Gangcheon's scheme in advance, Mun Saseung successfully completes the tribute porcelain. Enraged by his failure, Gangcheon orders Mapung to kill Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. Miranda promises radiantly fresh laundry, which she delivers again the same day. And so there is always something going on in her tiny laundrette in the harbour. It turns into a karaoke bar in the evening, because that is Miranda's great passion. Eban Olliver has many jobs at once. He is the lighthouse keeper of Kingstown. And that means a lot of responsibility in St. Vincent's biggest port city. Because Eban doesn't just change the light bulbs, he's a pilot dispatcher, harbour master and guard all in one person. First contact with ships is particularly important. Once he even saved the entire nation from an Ebola virus.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm's urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life's element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode of the documentary series Andreas Kieling reports from the Amazon basin, Siberia, South Africa, the mountains of western China and the Eiffel region back home in Germany. Kieling ventures to western China almost as far as the border with Tibet in search of the great panda, the legendary bamboo bear. Set against a gigantic natural backdrop, the filmmaker is attempting to track down the extremely reclusive creature. But finding one of the approximately 3000 pandas who live in the vast mountainous landscape and capturing it on camera is like searching for a needle in a haystack. And then comes a stunning close encounter with the beautiful creatures at a very special place: the breeding station at Wulong. The precious bears live in huge natural enclosures here, breeding and providing specimens to be loaned to a number of zoos all over the world. These particular creatures are only able to serve as ambassadors for their few relatives who still live in the wild since they have become accustomed to captivity, they would not be able to survive by themselves in the rainforests.

programme.title: The Tundra: Desert of Ice

programme.title: Between Finland and Sweden
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea to this day. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. More than double the size of the Netherlands, it is the most unknown region of the Baltic Sea. In the winter, the Baltic Sea freezes over at a length of 300 kilometres. In this 1-metre-thick ice tank, the third species of seal - alongside the grey seal and common seal - copes well with the Baltic Sea. The ringed seal is perfectly adapted to the Arctic winter and carves out breathing holes into the ice. More than 10,000 of the animals still live between Sweden and Finland. The Bay of Bothnia only has a salt content of just 1%, which is why it freezes quicker than other regions of the Baltic Sea. Many rivers disembogue here and “sweeten” the sea. The Tornio is the longest natural river in Europe. It forms the border between Sweden and Finland. Even when frost is severe, the Kukkolaforsen rapids in Sweden never freeze over, otters go hunting here. When it gets dark in the winter, solar winds conjure colourful light effects in the Baltic Sea sky. The Aurora Borealis can be seen in the northern regions of the Baltic Sea as of mid-October. The coast of Lapland is also the home of the reindeer. The Sami's, reindeer breeders, bring their herds in winter to the Baltic Sea, as the snow is not as deep here as it is further inland and the animals have better access to lichens and mosses. When Lapland's coast is still frozen, 300 kilometres further south in the Kvarken Archipelago, a special spectacle takes place. Millions of fish head for the coast. Barrier beaches prevent them from reaching the coastal lagoons. They can only spawn where the water is salt-free.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the hottest newtro master PARKMOONCHI! PARKMOONCHI became known to the public through the variety show Hangout with Yoo where she displayed her exceptional ability to put her own contemporary spin to 1990s music. That sensational appearance led her to actively collaborate with numerous big names in the music scene including Suho and Baekhyun from EXO Kang Daniel Kwon Jin Ah and Young K from Day6. Also known for her witty and unexpectional point of view PARKMOONCHI shares with everyone how the Generagion MZ enjoys the music and culture of older generations - no wonder how she became an icon of MZers. In September this year PARKMOONCHI released a new EP named ParkRuRa with RuRu and RaRa. Combining R&B new jack swing and soul music the three musicians also known as PARKMOONCHI UNIVERSE show off their unique yet beautiful universe under their motto Pursuing joy and happiness together In this episode PARKMOONCHI performs m e s s a g e . . . and Move! from the album ParkRuRa her cover of Lee Ye-rin's Come On Baby Tonight as well as I Want To Hold Your Hand and The Story Of The Year with Onewoo. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this delightful and unpredicted artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is talented vocalist BAEK A YEON! Known for her crystal clear voice BAEK A YEON made her big debut in 2012 after making it to the top three of the popular talent search show K-Pop Star in 2011. Then she dominated the top spots of various music charts and shows with the song Shouldn't Have... which she wrote at the end of a disappointing relationship. After that she released more songs about love oftentimes unrequited love including Looking For Love and so-so which has eventually become her own genre. In this episode BAEK A YEON performs Shouldn't Have... so-so Sweet Lies a Good Boy Jealousy and 0% the lead single off her latest album Observe. Tune in to I'm LIVE and fall in love with her crystalline voice once again!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter eldon! This artist became known to the public after taking part in the TV program Superstar K Season 7 where he made it to the top 5. Then in 2016 he officially made his debut as the vocalist of Martin Smith and once again surprised the public with his rhythmical vibes and songwriting skills. 2 years later in 2018 he started his career as a solo artist under his new stage name eldon. From his debut single Ghost! to Pink cheeks to Do monsters love too? he has already released an impressive set of albums which are full of his personal feelings and experiences. Also Pink cheeks was featured in the hit TV series My Roommate Is a Gumiho and widened his reach in the industry. In this episode eldon performs Pink cheeks Back to you and more to show off his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet eldon!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are four guys performing under the slogan of “chaotic world warm music” - it's Nerd Connection! This band is composed of four graduates of Yonsei University one of the most prestigious universities in Korea. The beginning was almost accidental - Vocalist Seo Yeong-ju and guitarist Choi Seung-won began performing together in 2012 as part of the university's rock band club Medusa. Then bassist Park Jae-hyun and drummer Shin Yeon-tae joined the band and they made their step into the professional music scene with their first single Hymn of the Birds in 2018. The same year they took part in the Emergenza Festival the world's largest festival for unsigned bands. After several regional qualifiers in Korea they passed the Korean qualification which led to the finals at a festival in Germany. With that unbelievable milestone at the very beginning stages of their career the four have pleasantly surprised listeners both at home and abroad until now. In October this year Nerd Connection released their first full-length album. All 12 songs in the album are tied under the concept of nostalgia for things gone by touching listeners in their unique way. In this episode the quartet performs 21st Century Kingdom Hollywood Movie Star Waterfall Bamboo Forest and Good Night Good Dream. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet the four highly talented musicians!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.
